interface.longDescription: Turn an attached room photo into one to three furnishing and decor concepts, then refine a selected concept. Every style starts from the same source photograph with instructions to preserve walls, doors, windows and viewpoint. Compare the original and results inline with Open, Download and fullscreen. Concepts may change geometry and are not measured plans or construction advice. Start using the tools without Firemoon account linking. An existing Firemoon account can optionally be connected to use its current entitlements.
